name: illustrator-live-vote-band
exporter: Adobe Illustrator 28.6 - Export As > SVG, Styling: Internal CSS, Responsive on
story: A club's own live-vote board, drawn as a wide band at the foot of frame: one question, three option rows, a bar track and a full-length bar per row, a percentage beside each, a VOTE NOW badge and one winner arrow per row switched off in the layers panel. The layers are named the way the drawing reads - Question, Option 1..3, Bar 1..3, Track 1..3, Percent 1..3, Winner 1..3, Vote badge, Total votes.
idioms: Generator comment naming the SVG Export Plug-In build
Responsive export: viewBox only, no width/height attributes
<style type="text/css"> holding one property per .stN class, several merged onto one text selector
three hidden layers exported as class="st13" whose single rule is display:none
every <text> positioned by transform="translate(...)" with no x/y of its own, as Illustrator writes it
_x20_ escapes with data-name on every named layer
whyThisMatters: The artwork behind the THIRD behaviour (docs/GRAPHIC_BEHAVIOUR_PLAN.md section 12): a poll board somebody drew, which a live audience vote has to drive. It is also the growth question asked from the other side - a board is a STAGE and must not resize, and every rectangle on this one is either full-frame (the band), text-free (the bars and tracks) or hard against the margin (the badge), so the measured default has to come back shrink. A file that proposed growth here would widen a bar the moment a long option was typed into the row beside it, which reads on air as a vote share that changed by itself.
